g.title: HR_COMPANYRELATIONSHIP
g.text: Company Relationship - Provides key information about an employment contract associated with a staffing assignment or staffing resource.
The Identifier of the Person record.
The identifier of the Worker Type record.
Specifies the last company assigned to the company relationship.
The Identifier of the Work Agency record.
Identifier of the Worker. Depending on the type of data representation, it could be the same as the Contract Id or an Employee Number which can stay fixed while the contract number changes.
This flag indicates if the assignment is primary or not.
The Identifier of the Start Reason record.
The Identifier of the End Reason record.
The date on which the associated person was hired. Some contexts and situations may require fine-grain distinctions. See Original Hire Date, Duty Entry Date.

A hire date that has been modified for a particular reason. Typically, this would not be the actual date of hire, but the date on which the person is treated as having been hired for pay or benefits purposes.
The Group Seniority Date is the start date of the first contract of a person regardless of the company within the group.
The Company Seniority Date is usually calculated from the start date of the first company assignment in that company.
The length of the Probation Period, expressed in a specific Time Unit (weeks, days, etc.).
Time Unit the probation period is expressed with.
The End Date of the Probation Period. Normally calculated from the Start Date of the Contract plus the Probation Period Length.
The length of the notice period, expressed in a specific time unit.
Time Unit the notice period is expressed with.
The date the Person gives notice to the company that they are leaving.
The End Date of the notice period. It is normally calculated as the Notice given date plus the length of the notice period.
The length of the Relationship Period, expressed in a specific Time Unit (weeks, days etc.).
Time Unit the Contract duration is expressed with.
This is the date the contract is expected to end.
The identifier of the Job Offer record.
The Identifier of the Protected Category record.
The amount of Taxable Pay from the previous employer.
The Tax Paid during the Previous Employment.
The date on which a person completes the necessary paperwork and is sworn in as an employee.
The amount of Taxable Pay from their previous employmer, in the system currency.
It's the Tax Paid in the Previous Employment expressed in system currency.
This field contains the seniority date for the line of business
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update

Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_PERSON
g.text: Person - Contains information identifying the person.
The Person's given, or first, name.

Contains a non-given name. This is an inherited name or one representing a family relationship or in some cultural contexts a Place Name (where someone is from). In some cultural contexts, a single family name is typical, while in others there may be multiple family names. .
A previous family name, such as a maiden name, which is a family name prior to marriage and assuming a spouse's name.
The name by which the person prefers to be called.
Contains a preferred form of address or salutation. For, example, Mr, Mrs, Ms, Dr, etc.
A letter or series of letters representing the first letter in each name part.
Could be used to accompany the name of the person with some descent title.
Usually an abreviation representing a qualification (a degree or certification, for example) held by a person. For example, BA, BSc, Beng, MSc, MD, RN, CPA, PhD, etc.
A portion of a name indicating generation Sr., Jr., III (the third), etc.

This is the complete name of a person, made up of the constituent parts (i.e. Family Name, Given Name). The formatCode is an optional attribute which specifies the applicable format. In the case of the Formatted Name of a person, some example formatCodes could be: ''Family Name, Given Name'', ''Given Name Middle Initial Family Name'' or ''First Initial. Family Name''.

Legal name used for legal documentation or other legal purposes. Contains, in one string, a fully formatted name with all of its pieces in their proper place. This includes all of the necessary punctuation.

An identifier issued to a person by a government organization. For example, a social insurance number or driver's license number. The schemeName typically would be used to reference the type of identifier (e.g., SSN, NC Drivers License) and the schemeAgencyID would be used to identify the issuing agency as necessary.
The Identifier of the Document Type record.
A code specifying gender. This list includes NotSpecified, which is different from the OAGIS gender list.
The date on which the person was born.
Indicates the place where the person was born.
Indicates the County where a person was born.
Indicates the City where a person was born.

A set of codes classifying a person's marital status. This is an HR-XML Open List. Standard effective dating and a certified date are available as attributes. Enumerated values are: Domestic Partner Divorced Married Unreported Separated Unmarried Widowed Legally Separated.

A code classifiying a person's current or past military status. Depending on the use case and applicable law, employers may need to track a varity of different information regarding a person's current or military status. Under applicable law, current or prior military personnel may be entitled to certain employment preferences.
The date on which the associated person died.
The primary or preferred language associated with a person or work environment.
The Identifier of the Nationality record.

A code classifying a person on the basis of their ethnicity. Ethnicity pertains to having common racial, cultural, religious, or linguistic characteristics. Ethnicity classifications may be relevant under government labor or fair employment practice regulations. For example, under U.S. record keeping rules for federal Contractors employers may require reporting of data with respect to whether or not a person is of Hispanic or Latino ethnicity, a classification which encompass persons of Mexican, Puerto Rican, Cuban, Central or South American, or other Spanish culture or origin, regardless of race.
The Identifier of the Race record.
Indicates if the Person is a smoker.

An indicator as to whether the Person is currently enrolled as a student within a specific class of educational institution. This is component is attributed with effective dating. A typeCode attribute is available to make fine-grain distinctions such as Full Time or Part Time status.
Used in Portugal. It is another way to format the full name of the Person.
This field contains the full Personal Picture, before any crop.
This is a small verson of the Person's picture, obtained by cropping and reducing the original in size.
This field can be used by an Employee to introduce themselves.
Indicates if the person has a valid Driving License.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
